title: BDF6 Deficiency Severely Compromises Intracellular Amastigote Development and Infectivity of Trypanosoma cruzi.
authors: Boselli Raposo, Victoria; Perdomo, Virginia; Pacini, Florencia; Cueto, Juan A; Pezza, Alejandro; Romano, Patricia S; Docampo, Roberto; Perez, Ana Rosa; Serra, Esteban
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用CRISPR/Cas9敲除布氏锥虫BDF6基因，发现其影响胞内无鞭毛体发育和感染性，但聚焦于寄生虫表观遗传调控而非核酸酶切割或碱基编辑机制，仅工具层面使用CRISPR，与本课题核心机制关联弱。
abstract: Trypanosoma cruzi, the causative agent of Chagas disease, relies on complex gene regulatory mechanisms to adapt to its diverse host environments. In recent years, it has been established that epigenetics plays an essential role in these mechanisms via the regulation of chromatin structure. Bromodomain-containing factors (BDFs), known for recognizing acetylated lysines on histones, have emerged as key factors in chromatin remodeling complexes. Among the eight predicted BDFs in T. cruzi, BDF6 is part of a TINTIN-like complex with MRGx and MRGBP, homologous to components of the NuA4/TIP60 chromatin remodeling complex. We generated knockout (KO) parasites for the bdf6 gene using CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing. BDF6 KO epimastigotes exhibit normal morphology but decreased size and growth, and the resulting metacyclic trypomastigotes displayed drastically reduced infectivity. Strikingly, once inside host cells, KO parasites differentiated into amastigotes but failed to replicate. This intracellular arrest was reversed by episomal complementation of BDF6. Consistently, KO parasites also exhibited impaired infectivity in mice, a defect that was also rescued in the addback parasite lines. Our findings highlight BDF6 as a critical regulator of intracellular parasite development, operating in stages beyond epimastigotes where epigenetic plasticity is essential for host adaptation. This striking stage-specific phenotype of BDF6 KO underscores its functional importance and highlights the relevance of epigenetic regulators along T. cruzi life cycle.
abstract_zh: 克氏锥虫（Trypanosoma cruzi）是恰加斯病的病原体，其依赖复杂的基因调控机制以适应多样的宿主环境。近年来，已确定表观遗传学通过调控染色质结构在这些机制中发挥重要作用。含溴结构域因子（BDFs）以识别组蛋白上乙酰化赖氨酸而闻名，已成为染色质重塑复合物中的关键因子。在克氏锥虫中预测的八个BDFs中，BDF6是包含MRGx和MRGBP的TINTIN样复合物的一部分，与NuA4/TIP60染色质重塑复合物的组分同源。我们利用CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑技术生成了bdf6基因敲除（KO）寄生虫。BDF6 KO上鞭毛体表现出正常形态，但尺寸和生长减少，由此产生的锥鞭毛体感染性显著降低。引人注目的是，一旦进入宿主细胞，KO寄生虫分化为无鞭毛体但未能复制。这种细胞内停滞通过附加体互补BDF6得以逆转。一致地，KO寄生虫在小鼠中也表现出受损的感染性，这一缺陷在回补寄生虫系中也得到挽救。我们的发现强调BDF6是细胞内寄生虫发育的关键调控因子，其作用阶段超越上鞭毛体，在这些阶段表观遗传可塑性对宿主适应至关重要。BDF6 KO的这种显著阶段特异性表型凸显了其功能重要性，并强调了表观遗传调控因子在克氏锥虫生命周期中的相关性。
